samples.summary: Only `handleCut`'s text path clears the image selection; other offset-shifting entry points (programmatic `EditorAPI.paste()`, `applySpellSuggestion`, `insertTable`/`insertPageNumber`) never call `imageSelectionClearer`, so `selectedImage` is left naming a shifted offset
samples.evidence: The diff establishes the invariant "a text mutation that shifts offsets must drop the coordinate-based image selection" and wires `imageSelectionClearer` into `TextEditor.handleCut` only (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:1259). Reachable bypass: `packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3386` `paste: async () => ... textEditor.pasteContent(...)`. Right-clicking a selected image does not clear the selection — `handleImageMouseDown` returns for `e.button !== 0` (editor.ts:2499) and for BUTTON targets (editor.ts:2500-2507) — and the context-menu Paste never goes through `handleKeyDown`/`imageKeyHandler`, whose catch-all is what clears the selection for Cmd+V. So Paste inserts at the image's offset and `selectedImage` afterwards points at whatever landed there; `applySpellSuggestion` (editor.ts:3360) shifts offsets in the same block the same way. The new re-validation in `imageSelectionProvider`/`deleteSelectedImageInline` mitigates the crash, but not the exact 'wrong image' hazard the diff's own cut test documents.

samples.summary: The stated motivation for the new `textEditorRef?.focus()` — copying a click-selected image in a read-only document — is unreachable: `handleImageMouseDown` returns early when `readOnly`, and no production caller uses `selectImageAt`
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2497 `const handleImageMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => { if (readOnly) return; ... }` — a viewer can never click-select an image, so the read-only branch the new focus call exists for ("a clicked image ... on a read-only document — which is exactly where the context menu now offers Copy") cannot occur. The only other producer of an image selection, `EditorAPI.selectImageAt` (editor.ts:3681), has no caller anywhere outside packages/docs tests (grep over packages/frontend and the rest of the repo returned only the interface declaration, the implementation and copy-integrity.test.ts). The read-only test at packages/docs/test/view/copy-integrity.test.ts:452 therefore covers a path production cannot enter; the context menu's read-only Copy in fact works because `TextEditor.handleMouseDown` already focuses the textarea unconditionally (text-editor.ts:1699).
searchedFor: grep selectImageAt|getSelectedImage across repo excluding tests

samples.summary: `selectImageInline` focuses the hidden textarea before the caret render repositions it, so the browser may scroll the container to the textarea's stale fixed position
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:5545-5551 documents the contract: the hidden textarea is `position: fixed` and is moved to the caret's screen position on each cursor render precisely "so the browser doesn't scroll the container to bring the textarea into view". `selectImageInline` (editor.ts:1255-1258) calls `textEditorRef?.focus()` before `cursor.moveTo(...)`/`render()` run at editor.ts:2551-2552, i.e. while the textarea still sits at the previous caret's coordinates — the focus can scroll the document away from the image the user just clicked. Reordering focus after the render (or syncing the textarea position first) would keep the existing contract.
searchedFor: read selectImageInline and its two call sites in editor.ts

verdict.reason: The invariant "an offset-shifting text mutation must drop the coordinate-based image selection" is enforced at exactly one site: TextEditor.handleCut's text branch calls this.imageSelectionClearer?.() (text-editor.ts:1259), the sole invocation in the repo of the hook assigned at editor.ts:2303. Other mutation entry points reach the same offset shift without it: EditorAPI.paste (editor.ts:3386) -> textEditor.pasteContent (3409/3417) -> pasteContent (text-editor.ts:1453-1462) -> pasteFromParts/applyPastePlan, which touch only readOnly/pasting/pending; and applySpellSuggestion (editor.ts:3360-3374), which replaces text and only markDirty/render. The bypass is reachable with a live image selection: handleImageMouseDown returns before its clearing branch for e.button !== 0 (editor.ts:2499) and for BUTTON/menu targets (2500-2507), and DocsContextMenu neither clears the selection on open (docs-context-menu.tsx:65-106) nor before invoking editor.paste() (250) / applySpellSuggestion (212); clearImageSelection has no production caller (only copy-integrity.test.ts:489). I enumerated every write to selectedImage in editor.ts (1257, 2272/2278, 2305, 2347/2367/2385, 2559-2560, 3690, 3803) and none is on a paste or spell path, so no counterexample exists. The re-validation in imageSelectionProvider (2287-2298) and deleteSelectedImageInline (2270-2275) prevents the crash/wrong-character delete but not the wrong-image hazard the diff's own test documents (copy-integrity.test.ts:844-876), and imageKeyHandler (2320) still intercepts Delete/arrows against the stale offset after the paste. Guard with a reachable bypass -> major, in the blast-radius lane.
